title: Convert ParentDashboardData/CurriculumSummary/RecentCompletion/EngagementMetrics to @freezed
why: These four domain-result classes are hand-rolled (final fields + const constructor, no ==/hashCode/copyWith) instead of @freezed, as the coding standard requires for domain/state models. No test in this batch currently compares whole-object equality, so this hasn't produced a false pass yet, but the first test that writes `expect(data.curricula.first, CurriculumSummary(...))` expecting structural equality will silently compare object identity instead.
recommendation: Annotate the four classes with @freezed, or record a documented judgment-call exception if they're deliberately excluded.
acceptance_criteria: The four classes are @freezed, or a coding-standards.md judgment-call entry documents why not.
